paragraphs.source_en: I saw nothing; but neither the sheep nor he would go on; so I bid him take the road lower down. Yet, still, I don’t like being out in the dark now; and I don’t like being left by myself in this grim house: I cannot help it; I shall be glad when they leave it, and shift to the Grange.
